biological_context: LTRC bulk lung eQTL/sQTL/apaQTL; COPDGene whole blood; Sakornsakolpat direct COPD GWAS
sample_size_or_unit: LTRC 1241 lung; COPDGene 3743 blood; 89 tested GWAS windows
accessibility: Public paper/supplement and browser; participant-level QTL restricted
genome_build: GRCh38 reported; verify each published table
variant_and_gene_identity: GWAS windows and variant rsIDs; QTL gene/feature IDs need table-level check
full_data_obtainable: Published posterior summaries yes; complete QTL matrices not established publicly
independence_from_V1: Independent lung/blood molecular cohorts vs GTEx, but reuses prior COPD GWAS and published coloc
approximate_burden: Small tables/browser; no bulk acquisition needed
decision_and_use: USE_FIRST as published locus/gene/QTL-mechanism crosswalk only
main_limit: 38 windows; article summary says 33 loci while results says 32; preserve discrepancy; no exact candidate causal label

biological_context: GTEx v8 non-diseased bulk lung cis-eQTL
sample_size_or_unit: 510 lung samples in prior audit; reconfirm exact method N
accessibility: Public tabix/full summary; participant genotypes controlled
variant_and_gene_identity: REF/ALT variant fields; ALT effect; Ensembl gene IDs; duplicate rsIDs need deduplication
full_data_obtainable: Yes, all cis gene statistics and QTL credible sets
independence_from_V1: Same GTEx project as V1 v10, therefore not independent biological replication; different release/processing
approximate_burden: ~3.9 GB full gene cis; ~3.3 MB credible sets; locus slices much smaller
decision_and_use: CONDITIONAL_USE for targeted regional QTL and method-gated coloc
main_limit: Full QTL does not rescue missing GWAS likelihood or multiple-signal checks

biological_context: GTEx v10 predominantly non-diseased bulk lung
sample_size_or_unit: Lung-specific N must be read from release metadata
accessibility: Public full associations, large; participant genotypes controlled
independence_from_V1: Same underlying project/release as V1 significant pairs
approximate_burden: Prior plan estimates ~260 GB all-tissue associations
decision_and_use: DEFER; use smaller targeted route first
main_limit: Significant-pair archive already local is insufficient for coloc

biological_context: Non-COPD bulk lung DNase-derived rE2G/ABC enhancer-to-gene prediction, one donor
variant_and_gene_identity: Element intervals and gene IDs; candidate overlap requires exact b38 coordinates
independence_from_V1: New gene-link prediction vs V1; correlated with ENCODE accessibility and ABC inputs
decision_and_use: USE thresholded file first as typed predictive evidence
main_limit: Prediction is not contact or endogenous regulation; rE2G and ABC not independent lines

biological_context: Primary bulk-lung promoter capture Hi-C; promoter-other and promoter-promoter
sample_size_or_unit: Two lung biosamples in prior audit; assay fragment units
genome_build: hg19/GRCh37 in prior audit; verify file header and restriction-fragment coordinates
variant_and_gene_identity: Promoter and other fragment intervals; gene labels require promoter annotation
independence_from_V1: Orthogonal chromatin-contact assay vs genotype-expression and sequence model
decision_and_use: CONDITIONAL_USE at unresolved predeclared elements after audited b37/b38 liftOver
main_limit: Contact at fragment scale, no allelic effect, no COPD cell-state specificity

biological_context: Normal and ILD lung cell-type pseudobulk eQTL, 38 cell types
sample_size_or_unit: 114 genotyped in paper: 66 ILD and 48 controls; GEO description lists 116 tissue donors
accessibility: Processed genome-wide results public; genotypes controlled
genome_build: GRCh38 appears in GEO sample records; verify QTL file header
variant_and_gene_identity: SNP info and gene IDs; exact allele/SE convention must be checked
full_data_obtainable: Processed results yes; participant genotypes no
independence_from_V1: Different individuals and cell-type resolution vs GTEx; ILD disease context not COPD
approximate_burden: All processed lineage files roughly 100 GB; individual 0.9-10.3 GB; SNPinfo 928.5 MB
decision_and_use: DEFER to selected lineage/locus only after bulk-lung unresolved targets
main_limit: Small cohort and ILD/normal rather than COPD; do not infer COPD-specific cell effects

biological_context: Published airway/lung functional variants, e.g. FAM13A edited allele
accessibility: Already curated locally; original papers public
variant_and_gene_identity: Usually rsID/haplotype; allele/build/target must be crosschecked
independence_from_V1: Potentially independent endogenous allele perturbation when exact variant and tested allele match
decision_and_use: USE only exact allele and experiment-matched links, with assay scope preserved
main_limit: A nearby/LD-linked published variant is external locus context only
